scope: Opt-in experimental mutable-map recovery; default Store and external atomic revision staging are unchanged.
correction: The original paged-delete probe assumed a particular collision order and could fail its setup assertion without injecting a clone panic. It was replaced with all 32 by 32 victim/failure combinations. The corrected test reproduces real lookup corruption against the frozen old library.
fixes: Stage shared-entry clones before installing replacement tables.
Prepare every affected probing page before opening a deletion hole.
Update counts and close probe chains before dropping removed user objects.
Use an unwinding length guard for sharded batches.
limits: Mutable-map batches remain nontransactional and may partially apply on panic; counts and reachability remain valid. Application-level revision publication still requires staging.
